cti_input.evidence: The attacker utilized PowerShell to download the payload from a remote server using Invoke-Expression.

hunting_plan.hypothesis: An adversary may be abusing PowerShell to execute encoded or download-and-execute commands on Windows endpoints.
telemetry: PowerShell Operational / Script Block Logging (Event ID 4104)
hunting_plan.evidence: The attacker utilized PowerShell to download the payload from a remote server using Invoke-Expression.
hunting_plan.sigma_rule:
title: "Suspicious PowerShell Execution"
status: experimental
description: "Baseline hunting rule generated from CTI ATT&CK mapping."
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_keywords:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - "-enc"
      - "-encodedcommand"
      - "Invoke-Expression"
      - "IEX("
      - "DownloadString"
      - "DownloadFile"
      - "FromBase64String"
      - "Invoke-WebRequest"
      - "New-Object Net.WebClient"
  condition: selection_image and selection_keywords
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity
level: medium

queries.kql_reference: SecurityEvents | where (Image endswith "\\powershell.exe" or Image endswith "\\pwsh.exe") and (CommandLine contains " -enc " or CommandLine contains " -encodedcommand " or CommandLine contains "invoke-expression" or CommandLine contains " iex(" or CommandLine contains "downloadstring" or CommandLine contains "downloadfile" or CommandLine contains "frombase64string" or CommandLine contains "invoke-webrequest" or CommandLine contains " iwr " or CommandLine contains "new-object net.webclient") | extend TechniqueId="T1059.001"
queries.spl_reference: index=security (Image="*\\powershell.exe" OR Image="*\\pwsh.exe") (CommandLine="* -enc *" OR CommandLine="* -encodedcommand *" OR CommandLine="*invoke-expression*" OR CommandLine="* iex(*" OR CommandLine="*downloadstring*" OR CommandLine="*downloadfile*" OR CommandLine="*frombase64string*" OR CommandLine="*invoke-webrequest*" OR CommandLine="* iwr *" OR CommandLine="*new-object net.webclient*") | eval TechniqueId="T1059.001"
